title: Dustbin haath pe kyu khulta hai, bag pe nahi? 🗑️ #shorts
description:
Dustbin haath dikhane pe khulta hai, par kabhi kabhi bag pe nahi. Kyu?
FC-51 IR sensor ka poora raaz 55 second mein!
🔦 IR LED invisible light bhejti hai
📡 Photodiode wapas aayi light pakadta hai
🧠 LM393 comparator decide karta hai
📏 Range 2-30 cm, angle 35°
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ke saath, har hafte ek module kholke dekhenge!
